wrong_setting: A modern dashboard with a car-stereo style screen and buttons and a glovebox-like cabinet puts him at the very front of the vehicle, looking out the front windshield, rather than in a passenger seat by a side window of an old bus.
notes: Repaint so the camera sits right behind his seat, with only his head and shoulders above the worn seat back, turned to a side window with more seats ahead; remove the dashboard and screen, add his backpack, and extend the painting to all four edges with no white paper margin.
